# Teaching 

### Applied Machine Learning in Python

I developed and taught this course for mathematics students at LMU Munich. The course introduces machine learning methods through interactive Jupyter notebooks, programming exercises, and open-ended projects. All the course materials are publicly available on GitHub.

➡️ **Course repository:** [Applied Machine Learning in Python](https://github.com/mselezniova/AppliedML)

<div style="height: 1.5rem;"></div>
